findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素稱併購能力取決於取得監管核准，包含日趨嚴格的合併管制與外國直接投資法規；搜尋未見 2026 年針對 TDY 的美國 DOJ／FTC 或歐盟反壟斷調查。
findings.excerpt: Our ability to make acquisitions depends on a number of factors, including the availability of potential acquisition candidates at reasonable prices, competition from other bidders, the ability to obtain regulatory approvals, including under increasingly stringent merger control and foreign direct investment laws, and the availability of debt and equity financing, among other factors.

findings.claim: 中國商務部 2025-04-04 對 Varex 啟動反傾銷調查並延長至 2026-10-03；兩位競爭法律師認為不太影響 SAMR 對 Teledyne 收購 Varex 的合併審查。
findings.excerpt: (MOFCOM) initiated an anti-dumping investigation involving Varex on 4 April 2025 and subsequently extended the investigation through 3 October 2026. Under the relevant rules, the investigation is expected to conclude shortly and cannot be extended further. Two competition lawyers told this news service that the anti-dumping investigation is unlikely to affect SAMR’s merger review.
